name: fix_php_elvis_swallows_falsy_config
description: Fixes a PHP config getter that uses `?:` (elvis) and wrongly returns the default for stored falsy values
prompts: Config::get in src/Config.php is documented to return the stored value for a key, and to return the caller's $default only when the key is ABSENT. It currently uses the elvis operator `?:`, which returns $default for any falsy stored value - so get("retries", 3) wrongly returns 3 instead of the stored integer 0, and get("prefix", "x") wrongly returns "x" instead of the stored empty string. Fix it (use the null-coalescing operator `??`, or array_key_exists) so a present key returns its stored value even when that value is falsy, while an absent key still returns $default. Keep the class and method signatures.

setup_files.src/Config.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Config
{
    /** @var array<string,mixed> */
    private array $values = [
        "retries" => 0,
        "prefix" => "",
        "name" => "app",
    ];

    // Return the stored value for $key. Only when $key is ABSENT should the
    // caller-supplied $default be returned; a stored falsy value such as the
    // integer 0 or the empty string "" must be returned as-is.
    // BUG: the elvis operator `?:` returns $default for ANY falsy stored
    // value, so get("retries", 3) wrongly yields 3 instead of the stored 0.
    public function get(string $key, $default = null)
    {
        return $this->values[$key] ?: $default;
    }
}

test_setup_files.tests/ConfigHiddenTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Config.php';

final class ConfigHiddenTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPresentFalsyIntIsReturned(): void
    {
        $c = new \App\Config();
        $this->assertSame(0, $c->get("retries", 3));
    }

    public function testPresentEmptyStringIsReturned(): void
    {
        $c = new \App\Config();
        $this->assertSame("", $c->get("prefix", "x"));
    }

    public function testPresentNormalValue(): void
    {
        $c = new \App\Config();
        $this->assertSame("app", $c->get("name", "?"));
    }

    public function testAbsentKeyReturnsDefault(): void
    {
        $c = new \App\Config();
        $this->assertSame("d", $c->get("missing", "d"));
    }
}
